name: strategy
summary: Swappable implementation family behind one interface — the seam for platform-specific behavior.
description: Creates a strategy interface plus a concrete implementation, bound in the DI container
problem: The same operation (caching, logging, payments, sending email) needs different implementations per platform or context, and consumers should not know or care which one they get. You want one contract, interchangeable implementations, and a DI binding that picks the active one.
appliesWhen: An operation has, or will have, more than one implementation (per platform, vendor, or context)
You want to isolate platform-specific code behind a platform-agnostic contract
Behavior must be swappable for testing (a test double implements the same interface)
The implementation should be chosen at wiring time, not hard-coded at call sites
avoidWhen: There is exactly one implementation and no plausible second — a plain class is simpler
The 'variants' differ by data, not behavior — use configuration via a provider instead
The interface would need many unrelated methods — split into smaller, focused strategies
You need to supply configuration values rather than perform operations — that's a provider
examples: Add a cache strategy with a Redis implementation
Isolate the platform-specific logging behind an interface
Create a driver seam for sending email
tradeoffs: Two files plus a DI binding. Strategies are the backbone of how PHPNomad stays platform-agnostic, but every strategy adds an indirection — keep interfaces minimal and behavior consistent across implementations.
outputs: A {name} strategy interface defining the contract
A DI binding mapping {implementation} to {name} in the initializer
postApply: Define the interface methods — focused, minimal, one type of operation
Implement them in {implementation}, keeping platform details contained there
Add further implementations (including a test double) as separate classes bound per context

name.aiHint: PascalCase, named for the operation family, conventionally ending in 'Strategy' (CacheStrategy, PaymentStrategy). This is the interface consumers type against.

implementation.aiHint: PascalCase, named for the platform or vendor plus the operation (RedisCache, WordPressCache, StripePayments). No 'Strategy' suffix on concretes.

initializer.description: FQCN of the initializer to register the DI binding in
initializer.aiHint: Pick the initializer that owns related bindings for this domain. If unsure, use the project's root initializer.
